name: URY admin page toolbar
describe: Full-bleed PageToolbar (breadcrumb, 18px/600 title, view toggle, border-b) followed by the sticky filter bar (bg-background/95 with blur, border-b, px 24 py 8) holding the "Jump to" pills and the Add item button.

First block inside the admin main area. The toolbar punches through the 24px gutter. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Plan", "Setup", the sample company, branch and department names and the sample date are translated here because ar.csv has no entry for them.
